pricing.single.description: Perfect for businesses with occasional hiring needs.

pricing.business.description: Ideal for growing companies with regular recruitment.
pricing.faq.q1: How long is each job posting active?
pricing.faq.a1: Each job posting stays active for 30 days. Business Package includes extended visibility options for longer campaigns.
pricing.faq.q2: Can I upgrade my package later?
pricing.faq.a2: Yes. You can upgrade from Single Posting to Business Package at any time and unlock advanced hiring tools immediately.
pricing.faq.q3: Do I need to create an account to post a job?
pricing.faq.a3: Yes. Create an employer account to purchase a package, post jobs, and manage applications in one place.
pricing.faq.a4: If a posting has not gone live yet, you can request a refund. Once published, package fees are non-refundable.
